verdict.rationale: New Relic documents a NerdGraph API explorer for experimenting with its GraphQL API (new-relic-docs-20), which offers interactive, runnable query examples, but this is the only interactive API-reference tool evidenced. Probes confirm no OpenAPI/REST interactive reference exists (404s for openapi.json/swagger.json), so REST API documentation lacks an equivalent interactive explorer. Missing for 10: a full OpenAPI/Swagger-style interactive reference for REST endpoints, independent/hands-on corroboration of the NerdGraph explorer's usability, and coverage beyond the single GraphQL API surface.
